summary: Iteration 18 verifies the two features requested by the user: (A) real per-user notification system (replaces the previous 100% dummy NotificationsBell.vue) with targeted permission-based delivery and a working 'Tandai' button, and (B) row-checkbox bulk actions on Users (activate/deactivate/delete) and Roles (delete). Backend: 80/80 pytest tests GREEN including 10 new tests for iteration 18 (TestIteration18Notifications, TestIteration18UsersBulk, TestIteration18RolesBulk). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright confirms the notification bell, bulk selection UI, and mobile 390 responsive on Users/Roles. All key behaviors validated: (1) mark-all-read: badge/dot go to 0 and read_at PERSISTS across page reload (verified via DB column); (2) single-item mark-read: read_at is set in DB and the endpoint returns 403 when POSTing on another user's notification (ownership check); (3) TARGETED delivery: creating user C as zulfame produces exactly one notification for user A (Super Admin with users.view), ZERO for user B (Staf, no users.view), and ZERO for zulfame (the actor) — verified via direct DB counts on the notifications table; (4) users bulk validation returns 422 for missing ids and unknown action; (5) users bulk deactivate→activate flips is_active correctly for QA users; (6) bulk delete skips zulfame when included in ids (self-skip) — no error, and target user is deleted; (7) roles bulk-destroy: 422 without ids; when ids include a QA role + Super Admin + Staf (in use by 23 users), only the QA role is deleted and Super Admin/Staf remain; (8) UI: bell popover shows Badge count and mark-all button, popover items list is real (not hardcoded dummies), red dot appears when unread>0 and disappears after mark-all; (9) DataTableCard emits users-select-all / users-select-<id> / users-bulk-bar / users-bulk-count / users-bulk-activate/deactivate/delete / users-bulk-clear and the mirror set for roles; select-all only picks CURRENT PAGE (verified: 10 selected on default 10-per-page); (10) responsive 390: checkbox column visible, doc.scrollWidth == innerWidth (no horizontal overflow). Zero console errors observed during full flow.
action_items: (Persistence, recurring) Branding defaults in App\Support\Branding::DEFAULTS still ship as 'AdminKit/AK/Admin Panel Starter Kit'. Because the values are cached forever and pods sometimes reset the settings row, this iteration again observed app_name reverting to 'AdminKit' — I restored CODEX via Setting::updateOrCreate + Branding::forget(). Consider a seeder guard that reapplies CODEX/Core Data Exchange/</>/CODEX: Core Data Exchange whenever the settings row is missing (same recommendation as iter 16).
critical_code_review_comments: Notify::toPermission iterates all active users and filters by can($permission) in PHP. That works today (46 roles / 22 users) but will become O(N*M) as user count grows. Recommendation: prefetch users via whereHas('roles.permissions', name=$permission) OR ('roles', name IN spatie_permission_role_has_permissions where permission=$permission) to filter at SQL level and avoid loading every user.

NotificationController::markRead uses '$notification->read_at ?? $notification->update([...])' — a clever null-coalesce short-circuit, but it silently returns success even when already-read; that's semantically OK but obscure. Prefer an explicit if-null guard for readability.

Notify::toPermission uses Notification::insert() (bulk) which BYPASSES model events/casts — fine here since Notification has no boot/observers, but note that Eloquent 'created_at' cast is not applied automatically and 'now()' is passed as Carbon; verify at DB level that timestamps are stored as strings compatible with SQLite datetime — currently OK.

BulkUserRequest / BulkRoleRequest expose 'ids.*: exists' — good, but note that submitting mixed valid/invalid ids causes 422 for the whole payload rather than a partial 'dilewati' outcome; align with users controller behavior (skip and count) if desired.

UserController::bulk uses whereKeyNot($request->user()->id) — correct self-skip. Ensure the same protection exists in a hypothetical roles bulk (currently only Super Admin+used skipped; a user cannot delete their own role only indirectly, which is fine).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification data-testids: notifications-trigger, notifications-count, notifications-dot, notifications-mark-all, notification-<id>, notification-<id>-unread-dot, notifications-empty. Bulk data-testids follow DataTableCard convention: {testid}-select-all, {testid}-select-<id>, {testid}-bulk-bar, {testid}-bulk-count, {testid}-bulk-clear where testid='users' or 'roles'. Users bulk actions: users-bulk-activate/deactivate/delete. Roles bulk action: roles-bulk-delete. The DataTableCard select-all uses pageIds (current page only) — this is verified. To create a targeted notification test, remember: Notify::toPermission excludes the actor (Auth::user()), so a notification will be created for OTHER active users holding the module permission. Best approach: assert DB row counts per user_id via php artisan tinker (already done in backend_test.py). NotificationsBell.vue uses Inertia router.post with 'only: [notifications]' partial reload — the shared props are refreshed without a full page reload. To induce a real notification for the logged-in user quickly for UI-only verification, POST /login with wrong password from a separate browser context — this triggers Notify::toPermission('activity.view') and zulfame (Super Admin) receives it. Route.web.php: /notifications/read-all and /notifications/{id}/read are under 'permission:profile.view' — every authenticated user has profile.view, so ownership is enforced INSIDE the controller (abort_unless user_id === Auth::id, 403), not by middleware.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (pre-iter 18): NotificationsBell.vue rendered a hardcoded array (e.g., 'Pengguna baru terdaftar' shown to every user regardless of role); the Tandai button only mutated local state, so a page reload restored the 'unread' badge. Fix implemented and verified this iteration: (1) new notifications table with (user_id, title, module, level, url, actor_id, read_at) and a per-user latest-N relation on the User model; (2) HandleInertiaRequests shares only Auth::user()->notifications() for both items and unread count (so B never sees A's notifications); (3) App\Support\Notify::toPermission filters recipients to $u->is_active && $u->can($permission) && $u->id !== Auth::id() and bulk-inserts one row per recipient; (4) NotificationController::markRead enforces $notification->user_id === Auth::id (403 otherwise) and markAllRead scopes to $request->user()->notifications(). Triggered from UserController::store/destroy + bulk (users.view), RoleController::store/destroy/bulkDestroy (roles.view), and failed logins (activity.view). Bulk feature RCA: DataTableCard now has selectable/selected props and page-scoped select-all logic (pageIds.every ⇒ isChecked; toggle union/difference); UserController::bulk validates via BulkUserRequest and always applies whereKeyNot(Auth::id()) to protect self; RoleController::bulkDestroy filters out Super Admin and roles with users_count>0.
